'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2023 Chișinău International Airport shooting]]
**Two people are killed and another is injured after a man [[mass shooting|opens fire]] at the [[Chișinău International Airport]] in [[Chișinău]], [[Moldova]]. The perpetrator is injured and detained. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-66070461 (BBC News)]
*[[Mali War]]
**The [[United Nations Security Council]] votes unanimously to end [[MINUSMA]], its peacekeeping mission in [[Mali]]. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/world/un-votes-to-end-its-peacekeeping-mission-in-mali-as-demanded-by-the-country-s-military-junta/ar-AA1dgoBy?ocid=entnewsntp&cvid=4daddb4c9027416f9fb9c7774c4dc028&ei=21 (MSN)]
*[[Killing of Nahel Merzouk]]
**[[Riot|Rioters]] set fire to the main [[public library]] in [[Marseille]] as [[civil unrest]] continues across [[France]]. More than 900 people have been arrested and [[Minister of the Interior (France)|Interior Minister]] [[Gérald Darmanin]] deploys an additional 45,000 [[National Police (France)|police officers]] to the streets. [https://www.freepressjournal.in/world/france-violence-rioters-burn-down-largest-public-library-in-marseille-visuals-surface (''Freepress Journal'')] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/live/world-europe-66049895 (BBC News)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[List of mass media in Austria]]
**''[[Wiener Zeitung]]'', one of the oldest newspapers still published in the world, ends its daily print after 320 years. [https://abcnews.go.com/Business/wireStory/stop-press-vienna-newspaper-wiener-zeitung-ends-daily-100534794 (The Associated Press via ABC News)]
*The initial phase of the [[Skyline (Honolulu)|Skyline]] [[Medium-capacity rail system|light metro rail]] formally opens to the public in [[Honolulu]], [[Hawaii]], [[United States|U.S]]. [https://www.hawaiinewsnow.com/2023/06/30/skylines-grand-opening-day-is-here-marking-major-milestone-hawaii-history/ (Hawaii News Now)] [https://www.railwayage.com/passenger/rapid-transit/skyline-opens-in-honolulu/ (Railway Age)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Kericho truck crash]]
**Fifty-two people are killed and 30 more injured in a [[multiple-vehicle collision]] involving a [[truck]] on a highway between [[Kericho]] and [[Nakuru]] in [[Kenya]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2023/6/30/dozens-killed-in-kenya-road-crash (Al Jazeera)]
*One person is killed and two others are injured by a 5.8 magnitude [[List of earthquakes in Indonesia|earthquake]] in [[Bantul Regency|Bambanglipuro]], [[Special Region of Yogyakarta]], [[Indonesia]]. [https://prsoloraya.pikiran-rakyat.com/nasional/pr-1116834880/update-gempa-bantul-1-warga-meninggal-dunia-2-luka-luka-puluhan-rumah-rusak-ringan-hingga-sedang (Jawapos)]
*Seven people are killed and nine others are injured after a building collapses in [[Abidjan]], [[Ivory Coast]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/seven-killed-building-collapse-ivory-coast-2023-07-01/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Romania–Russia relations]]
**Around 40 Russian diplomatic staff members leave [[Bucharest]] amid worsening relations between the two countries. [https://www.rferl.org/amp/romania-russian-diplomats-leave-rising-tensions/32485158.html (Radio Free Europe/Radio Liberty)]

'''Law and crime'''
*''[[Biden v. Nebraska]]''
**In a 6–3 decision, the [[Supreme Court of the United States|U.S. Supreme Court]] rules that the [[United States Secretary of Education|Secretary of Education]] does not have the power to waive student loans under the [[Higher Education Relief Opportunities For Students Act|HEROES Act]]. [https://apnews.com/article/student-loan-forgiveness-supreme-court-653c2e9c085863bdbf81f125f87669fa (AP)]
*In a 5–2 vote, the [[Superior Electoral Court]] of [[Brazil]] rules to ban former president [[Jair Bolsonaro]] from holding public office for eight years due to his conduct during last year's [[2022 Brazilian general election|election]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/political-career-brazils-bolsonaro-dangles-by-thread-electoral-trial-nears-end-2023-06-30/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[IceCube Neutrino Observatory|IceCube Collaboration]], a detector operating at the [[Amundsen-Scott South Pole Station]], detects evidence of high-energy [[neutrino]] emission from the [[Milky Way]] galaxy. [https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/science.adc9818 (''Science'')]
*The [[Australian Space Agency]] cancels its [[Australian dollar|AU$]]1.2 billion ([[United States dollar|US$]]770 million) [[satellite]] program launched last year, citing [[Australian federal budget|budgetary]] adjustments amid a [[2021–2023 inflation surge|financial crisis]]. [https://www.manilatimes.net/2023/07/01/world/australia-scraps-satellite-program/1898537 (AFP via ''The Manila Times'')]
